name: Shram Yogi Prasad Scheme
nodalDept: BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD
briefDescription: The Shram Yogi Prasad Scheme provides daily mid-day meals and breakfast to construction workers registered with the BOCW Welfare Board in Dadra Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu.
descriptionMd: The Shram Yogi Prasad Scheme is a crucial welfare initiative launched by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD. It aims to support the health and well-being of registered construction workers by providing essential nutritional support through daily meals and breakfast. This scheme underscores the administration's commitment to the welfare of its labor force.
benefitsMd:
*   Provides mid day meal
*   Provides breakfast
*   Supports the nutritional needs of registered construction workers
eligibilityMd:
*   Must be a construction worker.
*   Must be registered with the BOCW Welfare Board.
*   Resides within the Union Territory of Dadra Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
